messages:
rachel: Quick bring-up for hf/vulcan-7b-intl (converted -> llama-like). Packed static int4 and ran long-context summarization suite. Short examples look fine but after ~1.8k tokens we see repeated clauses and drifting facts. Also notice kv resume oddities when prefixing system messages.

samir: repro command used on ded-2:
```bash
./run_eval --model vulcan-7b --quant static-int4 --prompts tests/long_news.txt --max-tokens 4096 --warmup 1
```

cheng: checked vocab mapping: upstream preserved zero-widths (U+200B) in several merges. ids ~5000..5012 are offset by +1 relative to our canonical map. Stripping U+200B before encode reduces boundary-aligned repeats in a quick smoke.

lin: kv warmup masks the problem: `--kvmode=warm` drops loop frequency by ~50% but doesn't fully eliminate hallucinations. Ran `rotary-inspect` and see tiny fractional offsets on two heads: head=2 offset=+0.0625, head=9 offset=-0.03125. Could be residual quant packing alignment or a proj-order quirk.

rachel: plan: 1) bake a converter shim to strip zero-widths + NFKC and reconvert (fast). 2) rerun with forced kv warmup and instrument kv checksums. 3) if still present, rebuild packs with per_head_scale=true and diff per-head checksums.

ops-bot: Created ticket RH-2801: "vulcan-7b int4 onboarding: tokenmap zero-width offsets + kv-resume divergence + tiny rotary phase offsets" assigned eng-ml. https://redwood.example/issue/RH-2801
